title: Trump demands major changes to childhood vaccine recommendations
description: The president signed an order advising states to revise their rules. He also called for narrowing which vaccines are administered to children and splitting shots into multiple appointments.

title: GOP lawmakers release Fauci texts discussing covid vaccine and pregnancy
description: The senators said the texts are among more than 34,000 recovered from a copy of the former government official’s iPhone.

title: Max Miller remains the GOP nominee in Ohio House race
description: A Monday afternoon deadline that would have allowed local party officials to select a replacement candidate has passed.

title: Hunter Biden tells Tucker Carlson that Trump poses an ‘existential threat’
description: Biden has made a point of talking to conservative media figures in recent months.

title: How the economy is hurting Republicans’ midterm chances
description: Voters right now broadly disapprove of the economy, Trump and, increasingly, Republicans in Congress.

title: Alabama heads into a second primary election after redistricting
description: Alabama voters are again selecting candidates for four Congressional districts after the state changed the district map to favor Republicans. The redistricting is causing confusion among voters.

title: Trump nominates loyalist to office that would oversee Reflecting Pool review
description: Dennis Kirk, a Project 2025 author who had worked for then-Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard, may now run Interior’s inspector general office.

title: Former president Barack Obama launches a new podcast
description: The show will feature interviews with guests about key books that have left an impact on them. It starts Sept. 24 on Audible.

title: After his Reflecting Pool vandalism case is dismissed, David Hearn looks for closure
description: The ex-Olympian accused of damaging the reflecting pool tells NPR the experience has been "Orwellian" and "Kafkaesque." And it's not over yet: His lawyers are fighting to close the case permanently.

title: Trump and RFK Jr. try again to upend vaccines for kids
description: President Trump signed an executive order on Monday about vaccines, saying children should get fewer. His administration has been blocked in the courts from changing the vaccine schedule.

title: 'The Nerd Reich' tracks the 'unmasking of Silicon Valley's true politics'
description: Journalist Gil Durán argues that a small circle of Silicon Valley billionaires and venture capitalists have concluded that democracy is in their way — and that they should be governing in its place.

title: What the Senate did and didn’t get done in the final hours before recess
description: Before leaving Saturday, lawmakers confirmed President Trump’s attorney general pick and passed a spending bill.

title: Voters want fighters. But where is the limit?
description: For years — really ever since the political rise of President Donald Trump — voters have told pollsters and reporters that they want to elect so-called fighters. This trend has also led to more candidates who attempt to shake off true political scandals.

title: Why a murder trial is beginning nearly 30 years after Tupac Shakur’s death
description: For decades, no one was arrested in Shakur’s 1996 killing. Then an ex-gang leader, Duane "Keffe D" Davis, started talking.

title: Eleventh-hour primary upsets muddy the race for control of Congress
description: Unexpected winners have complicated both parties’ paths to control of the House and Senate.

title: A twist in the race for Lindsey Graham’s seat: No clear Trump-aligned candidate
description: The president backs Graham’s sister, but each contender in South Carolina’s Senate primary has found themselves out of step with him in some way, and a runoff is likely.

title: In a competitive Maine Senate race, women voters could be the deciders
description: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of this year's most high-profile Senate contests. To win, both candidates will need support from an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

title: Mike Lindell touts Trump ties in race for governor of Minnesota, where Trump has lost
description: Lindell, of MyPillow, plays up his ties to Trump, who endorsed him for Tuesday's primary. But the state Republican convention backed one of his opponents.

title: Voters are sick of the 2-party system. A new poll shows they're open to big changes
description: A new poll shows support for moving the U.S. toward proportional representation, a system that elects multiple representatives in a single district in rough proportion to a party's vote share.

title: Faith is a centerpiece of Texas Senate candidate James Talarico's campaign
description: James Talarico, Texas' Democratic Senate nominee, is putting faith at the center of his campaign. Republicans are pushing back. Control over the U.S. Senate hangs in the balance.

title: Trump picks longtime aide Will Scharf as new top White House lawyer
description: The White House staff secretary replaces David Warrington, who is leaving for the private sector.

title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez says she’s freezing her eggs
description: The Democratic congresswoman, 36, said she made the decision to undergo the fertility procedure to “feel more in control of my life.”

title: After bitter primary, El-Sayed faces daunting task of unifying Democrats
description: Before going up against Republican Mike Rogers in November, Abdul El-Sayed must heal the wounds from his fierce race against Rep. Haley Stevens.

title: Window closes for Ohio GOP to replace Rep. Max Miller on the ballot
description: The Republican congressman, who denies claims of domestic abuse, has resisted growing calls to drop his bid for a third term.

title: Group urges Democrats to woo moderate voters with populist policies
description: A progressive group says messages that target the wealthy and large corporations appeal to a majority of Americans who see the economy as fundamentally rigged.

title: Max Miller is refusing to drop his bid for reelection. Here's what voters think
description: Voters in Ohio's 7th Congressional district react to calls for Rep. Max Miller to drop his bid for reelection. He ran uncontested in the May 5 GOP primary. The Democratic nominee is Brian Poindexter.

title: Blanche as AG faces pressure from Trump, skeptical courts, low staff morale
description: As Todd Blanche officially takes over at the helm, the challenges for the Justice Department have been stacking up.

title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
description: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency.
